declare.en: Pick an enemy unit that does not have **FLY** and that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.

effect.en: Roll 6 dice. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

declare.en: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.

effect.en: Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Heavy Sky Ordnance** is 3.
This unit can transport up to 2 friendly **KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY** units with a combined model count of up to 12 (see Battle Traits).

declare.en: This unit cannot use this ability if it is in combat or has used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability this turn. Pick a number of units up to its Transport Capacity that are wholly within 6" of it, that are not in combat and that have not charged this turn to be the targets. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.

effect.en:
This unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll and must end the move within ½" of a visible enemy unit. If it does so:

• Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within this unit’s combat range. The targets can be set up in combat.
• This unit and the targets have charged, and the targets cannot use another **CORE** ability this phase.
• Pick up to 1 of the targets to have **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Great Sky Ordnance** is 4.
This unit can transport up to 3 friendly **KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY** units with a combined model count of up to 22 (see Battle Traits).

effect.en: Roll 10 dice. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

effect.en: Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

declare.en: Pick up to 2 other friendly **SKYFARER** units within this unit’s combat range to be the targets.

effect.en: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets’ melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

timing.en: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase

declare.en: Pick up to 3 visible friendly **SKYVESSELS** wholly within 24" of this unit that are not in combat to be the targets.

effect.en: Each target can use a **RUN** ability and still use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.

declare.en: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

effect.en: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

declare.en: Pick this unit and up to 1 friendly **Endrinriggers** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

effect.en: For the rest of the turn, combat attacks made by the targets against enemy units that charged this turn have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

declare.en: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** or **Zontari Endrin Dock** within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

effect.en: Roll a dice. On a 2+, **Heal (3)** the target.

units.notes_en: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Guild Officer*.

declare.en: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** or **Zontari Endrin Dock** within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

effect.en: Make a field repairs roll of D6 for each model in this unit. For each 4-5, **Heal (1)** the target. For each 6, **Heal (2)** the target.

wargear.en:
• ***Each model in this unit is armed with a Rapid-fire Rivet Gun and Aethermatic Saw.***
• ***1/3 models can replace their weapons with an Aethermatic Volley Gun and Gun Butt.***
• ***1/3 models can replace their weapons with a Skyrigger Heavy Weapon (Grapnel Launcher, Skyhook or Drill Launcher) and Gun Butt.***
• ***The champion cannot replace their weapons.***

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

declare.en: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.

effect.en: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
When you use the ‘Transport Skyfarers’ ability for this unit, you can pick units in combat to be targets.
This unit can transport 1 friendly **KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY** unit with a model count of up to 5 (see Battle Traits).

declare.en: Pick an enemy unit that does not have **FLY** and that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.

effect.en: Roll 4 dice. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
Double the Damage characteristic of this unit’s weapons for attacks that target **PRIESTS**, **WIZARDS** or **MANIFESTATIONS**.

While they are wholly within 12" of this unit, friendly **SKYFARER** units have **WARD (5+)** against mortal damage inflicted by **SPELL** abilities, **PRAYER** abilities and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS**.

units.notes_en: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a *Guild Officer*.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

effect.en:
Until the start of your next turn, if this unit has not charged in the same turn, the following cumulative effects apply depending on your **fury level**.

**1+ *Irked***: This unit’s **Aethermatic Saws** have **Crit (Auto-wound)**.
**4+ *Exasperated***: This unit has **WARD (5+)**.
**7 *Incensed***: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.

units.notes_en: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General's Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

• ***1/3 models can replace their weapons with a Skyrigger Heavy Weapon (Grapnel Launcher, Skyhook or Drill Launcher) and Gun Butt.***
• ***The champion cannot replace their weapons.***

effect.en:
• This unit can use **UNBIND** and **BANISH** abilities as if it had **WIZARD (1)**.
• Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making unbinding rolls and banishment rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.

Each time your opponent spends any **rage dice** as part of the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability, after that ability has been resolved, if this unit is not in combat, it can move up to **X**D6", where **X** is the number of **rage dice** spent. It cannot end that move in combat.

units.notes_en:
This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a *Guild Officer*.

This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General's Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

effect.en: If this unit used a **SHOOT** ability this phase, this unit can move D6". It cannot end that move in combat.
While this unit is wholly within 12" of any other friendly **Grundstok Gunhaulers**, it can use **SHOOT** abilities even if it used the ‘Run’ ability in the same turn.
This unit cannot transport any friendly units.

units.notes_en:
This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.
This unit can be reinforced even though it has a minimum unit size of 1.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn

declare.en: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

effect.en:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:

• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• This unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.

• ***1/3 models can replace their weapons with an Aethermatic Volley Gun and Gun Butt.***
• ***1/3 models can replace their weapons with a Skyrigger Heavy Weapon (Grapnel Launcher, Skyhook or Drill Launcher) and Gun Butt.***
• ***The champion cannot replace their weapons.***

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

effect.en: If this unit is in combat, it can move 2D6" but must end that move in combat.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

declare.en: Pick an objective within 9" of this unit to be the target.

effect.en:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the following effects for the rest of the turn:

• Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **SKYFARER** units that target a unit that is contesting the target objective.
• Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **Vongrim Salvagers** and **Vongrim Harpoon Crew** units for attacks that target a unit that is contesting the target objective.
